annotations.title: Send the owner a one-tap claim link (to the email on file)

description: For a business OWNER (or their AI assistant) who wants to claim their free AssistAnt 24/7 listing. Emails a one-tap claim link plus a 6-digit code to the email address ALREADY ON FILE for that business (never to an address you supply). Whoever reads that inbox opens the email and taps the link once: the listing is claimed, with a free website and the weekly AI Boost routine. Takes the listing_id (owner_tools.listing_id in find_pro_by_name results). Intended for the owner of the business or someone acting for them. If there is no email on file, it says so and gives the phone-code claim page instead.
name: send_claim_link
title: Send the owner a one-tap claim link (to the email on file)
